messages:
jacob-customer: Hi team — we received a customer report that their $500 trial credit never showed up on their project after SSO migration. They say they can see the credit in Billing UI but it's not available when they try API calls. Anyone familiar?

maria-cs: can you paste the org id the customer sees in Billing and the org id they use in API token requests?

jacob-customer: Billing UI org: org_01G8X5Y9ZABCD (shows balance $500). API requests use org header X-Redwood-Org: org_01G8X5Y9EFGH. They say the second org was created during their IdP reprovision.

maria-cs: thanks. @devon-ops can you check if we have two orgs linked to the same SSO email? Could be duplicate workspace created on SAML reprovision.

devon-ops: looking... grep on IDP user mappings shows two orgs with same primary_owner email (peter@acme.com). org_01G8X5Y9ZABCD (created 2026-03-02) and org_01G8X5Y9EFGH (created 2026-03-12). The latter has no billing attachment but IS the org the customer's API key is scoped to.

maria-cs: ok that matches their symptom — credits are attached to the older org but their active API key is scoped to the new orphan org. @alex-sre can you confirm any code path that attaches promo/trial grants during SSO reprovision?

alex-sre: quick summary: grant flow runs when an org is created + when we process a promotion webhook. I pulled the audit log for grant events: PromoGrantService applied trial credit to org_01G8X5Y9ZABCD at 2026-03-02. No grant for the newer org. The IdP reprovision path created a new org record instead of remapping in some edge cases (duplicate external_id). Root cause looks like a race between SSO-provision and our org-merge guard not triggering.

maria-cs: thanks. Jacob — we'll need to move the $500 from org_01G8X5Y9ZABCD to org_01G8X5Y9EFGH or re-scope the customer's API key. Which do they prefer?

jacob-customer: customer asked for credits moved to the org tied to their API key (org_01G8X5Y9EFGH). They also want to avoid redoing SSO.

maria-cs: good. I'll escalate to billing for a manual transfer and open an eng ticket to add a guard to the SSO path. @billing-bot — request manual credit transfer: from org_01G8X5Y9ZABCD -> org_01G8X5Y9EFGH amount 500 USD, reason: orphaned trial credit after SSO reprovision (REF #CS-2026-342).

billing-bot: Received transfer request REF CS-2026-342. Queued for manual review by Billing Ops. ETA 1 business day.

alex-sre: created infra ticket INF-7312: "SSO reprovision duplicate-org guard + auto-detect orphaned credits". Proposed mitigation: before creating a new org on SSO, attempt remap by external_id/email and, if a new org is created, emit warning and attach any recent promo events to both orgs pending human review. Also adding a periodic audit that flags promo balances > $0 on orgs with no active seats.

devon-ops: repro steps I used in staging: 1) Provision org A via SSO. 2) Trigger identity reprovision (simulate IdP user external_id change). 3) Reprovision creates org B but sets primary_owner to same email. 4) PromoGrantService only runs for org A earlier. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-12T14:22:17Z] SSO: provision new org org_01G8X5Y9EFGH for external_id x-789
[2026-03-12T14:22:18Z] OrgService: created org with owner peter@acme.com
[2026-03-12T14:22:18Z] PromoGrantService: no grant found for new org
```

maria-cs: great repro. Jacob, billing will update when transfer is done. We'll keep ticket INF-7312 open until guard lands. As interim, if other customers report this we can offer manual transfer.

jacob-customer: thanks all. Please keep me posted — customer is waiting for confirmation before launching.

billing-bot: Transfer REF CS-2026-342 completed. $500 applied to org_01G8X5Y9EFGH. Audit log entry: TXN-889102.

maria-cs: confirmed with customer — they see $500 available now and API calls succeed. Closing action: Billing transfer done, INF-7312 created, add runbook step for CS to request manual transfer. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
